_comment: Pre-race data for the most recent race weekend. n8n overwrites this each Thursday. Race info sourced from F1 official + RaceFans + Sky Sports for Suzuka 2026.

track_stats.character_note: Figure-of-eight. The Esses, Degner, Spoon and 130R reward bravery and punish the rest.

storylines.headline: Mercedes look uncatchable through two rounds
storylines.blurb: Two one-twos in two races. Russell leads, Antonelli is the youngest race winner ever. Suzuka's flowing layout might suit them even better.

storylines.headline: McLaren still searching for a finish
storylines.blurb: A double DNS in Shanghai followed a quiet Australia. Whatever's wrong with the new car, this is the worst possible weekend to find out it isn't fixed.

storylines.headline: Verstappen unbeaten at Suzuka since 2022
storylines.blurb: Four straight wins here, but in a Red Bull off the pace this year. The crowd will be loud either way — they'll be louder if he steals it.

things_to_watch: If it rains in qualifying — which the forecast just barely allows for — the order resets. Suzuka in the wet is the most demanding lap on the calendar, and Antonelli has never driven it. Watch the timing screens during Q1.
